action: Toyota customers and partners: no specific action while this is unconfirmed. Watch for an official company statement, be cautious of unexpected messages using your personal details, and do not act on contact from the claimed attackers.
exec: An unverified extortion-group claim against Toyota; treat as unconfirmed until the company responds.
plain: A criminal group calling itself BYOD claims it stole Toyota customer contact details and dates of birth and got into kiosk devices. Toyota has not confirmed this and no numbers are known.
summary: The group updated a leak-site listing claiming it stole customer contact details and dates of birth and accessed kiosk devices. Toyota has not verified the claim and no record counts are known.
title: BYOD ransomware group claims Toyota data theft

validation.note: Leak-site claim; Toyota has not verified it.
